text:
```yaml
name: Release Please

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run Release Please
        id: release-please
        uses: google-github-actions/release-please-action@v3
        with:
          path: .
          component: material-web
          bump-minor-pre-major: true
          release-type: library
          draft: false
          autorelease-pr-labels: "autorelease: pending"
          autorelease-pr-title: "chore(release): bump version"

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: steps.release-please.outputs.pr_created == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: ${{ steps.release-please.outputs.commit_message }}
          branch: release-${{ github.ref_name }}
          title: ${{ steps.release-please.outputs.pull_request_title }}
          body: ${{ steps.release-please.outputs.pull_request_body }}
          labels: ${{ steps.release-please.outputs.pull_request_labels }}
          reviewers: ''
          assignees: ''
```
